name: delete-guard
description: Deleting outside the project folder requires the user's approval (Bash, PowerShell, cmd, subagents, MCP).

boundary.title: Boundary folder
boundary.description: Folder inside which deleting needs no approval. Empty: the folder the session was started in. An absolute path or ~ for your home folder, e.g. ~ or ~/projects (Windows: ~\projects or C:\Users\you\projects).

allowedFolders.title: Allowed folders
allowedFolders.description: More folders inside which deleting needs no approval, in addition to the boundary, separated by commas, e.g. /tmp, ~/Downloads. An absolute path or ~/…. "Immer erlauben" (always allow) in the dialog adds folders here.

unresolved.title: Unresolvable targets
unresolved.description: When a delete target cannot be worked out from the command (computed paths, loops, $(…)): "ki" lets a model work it out and the mod checks the result with its own rules (no question if everything is inside); "fragen" always asks; "liste" refuses the call and tells Claude to pass an explicit list of paths.

aiModel.title: Model for the AI check
aiModel.description: Model alias or id used when "Unresolvable targets" is "ki", e.g. sonnet, haiku, opus.
